answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**
单面板组合图：39 个类别槽（GRC…CRI，含内嵌的 OECD 平均），每槽一根深绿柱（Women）加一个绿色菱形点（Men），共约 78 个标记；柱可正可负，零线穿过图中；绘图区为浅灰底色；图例位于标题与绘图区之间的灰条内，序列名带排序箭头「Women (↗)」；纵轴刻度 6 到 -12、步长 2，单位「p.p」写在最高刻度之上；横轴为约 45° 旋转的三字母国家代码；红色单柱把 OECD 标为聚合值；图下有 Note/Source 与 StatLink 链接。

**定位一个值难在哪**
以 -2.0（OECD 的 Women 柱，红色）为例：图上不印数字，刻度间距 2 p.p，而 5% 容差只有 0.1 p.p；同时 OECD 柱与相邻 FIN、ITA 的柱几乎同高，仅靠颜色区分聚合行；一行还要同时携带「OECD」与「Women (↗)」两个标签，箭头字符是否被解析器保留也不确定。

**不确定的**
绘图区是否有网格线看不清；-9.5 出现两次，我按 ESP 的柱与菱形分配，也可能是 GRC 柱；-6.2/-6.3、2.5 的国家归属为按位置推测（SVK、IRL、COL）。

heading.title: Change in unemployment risk by gender
heading.subtitle: Percentage point change in unemployment rate by gender, 2015-22

axes.serves: all Women bars and all Men diamonds

worked_example.why_hard: No printed value; ticks every 2 p.p; red OECD bar sits among near-identical neighbouring bars.

components.evidence: dark green bars for Women plus green diamond markers for Men in the same panel
axis reads 6 down to -12; most bars hang below the drawn 0 line
the OECD bar is red while every other bar is dark green
grey band with 'Women (\u2197)' and 'Men' sits between subtitle and plot area
'Note: OECD is the unweighted average...' and 'Source: OECD calculations based on...'
'StatLink' logo with 'https://stat.link/46w2xu' under the note lines
'GRC', 'ESP', 'SVK' ... 'CRI' set at roughly 45 degrees under the axis
category ticks are three-letter codes: GRC, ESP, SVK, NLD, OECD, CRI
'p.p' printed above the top tick '6' at the left axis
'Percentage point change in unemployment rate by gender, 2015-22' under the title
the plot area carries a light grey fill from 6 down to -12
'Men' drawn only as a small diamond at each country position, on the bars' axis

new_components.name: sort_direction_marker_in_legend
new_components.evidence: legend entry reads 'Women (\u2197)', the arrow marking the series the countries are sorted by

new_components.name: unit_abbreviation_defined_in_note

new_components.name: aggregate_row_inside_category_axis
new_components.evidence: 'OECD' sits between FIN and ITA on the country axis, not at either end

the GRC Men diamond, just below the -10 tick
the ESP Men diamond, sitting near the foot of the ESP bar
the IRL Men diamond, between the -6 and -8 region

answer.hardest_step_why: 无数值标注，刻度间隔2 p.p；-2.0与-2.1的5%容差仅0.1 p.p，OECD柱与邻柱像素几乎无差。

examples.quote: y axis ticks 6, 4, 2, 0, -2 ... -12; no number printed on any of the 78 marks
examples.why: 每个标记的可读精度不同：4.2可近似读出，-2.0/-2.1无法达到0.1 p.p容差。

examples.quote: the OECD bar is drawn red; all 38 country bars are dark green; legend names only 'Women (\u2197)' and 'Men'
examples.why: 颜色单独编码「聚合平均」这一属性，图例不含它，需进入键。

examples.quote: bars hang downward from a drawn zero line; 'p.p' set above the top tick '6'
examples.why: 负值向下加零线、单位置于顶刻度上方，这些样式维度目前不可控。

examples.quote: green diamonds for 'Men' overlaid at each country slot on the same axis as the 'Women (\u2197)' bars
examples.why: 同轴双标记形状，取值必须记录读自柱还是菱形。

examples.quote: legend text 'Women (\u2197)' \u2014 the arrow marks the series the 39 country slots are sorted by
examples.why: 图例内含排序标记，需在序列名中生成非文字符号并保持逐字一致。
